Ad Library note: the copy is set in bold Unicode pseudo-letters (U+1D400 block); reproduced here in plain capitals. The same ad runs about 9 near-identical creative variants.

ad_library.summary: 1 live Meta ad confirmed on 2026-11-21 on the Sri Narayana Enterprise Solar Energies page (page ID 936862456183233, started 13 Nov 2026), running about 9 near-identical Telugu/English creative variants that all carry the same line - 'Subsidy Upto 78,000/-(T&C Apply)' - and all click to WhatsApp. No website audit was run: the company's own domain srinarayanasolarenergies.com did not load on the day, and the website the ad itself names is another firm's site.

funnel.destination: WhatsApp (API.WHATSAPP.COM) - 'Send WhatsApp Message' on every variant
funnel.meaning: Every variant of the ad clicks to a WhatsApp chat, and the website named in the ad belongs to a different company. There is no page of Sri Narayana's own anywhere in the paid path, so nothing can be measured, retargeted or corrected once the buyer arrives.

findings: The ad's own 'Website' line points at www.sribalajisolarenergies.com - the live site of Sri Balaji Solar Energies in Hanumakonda, a separately branded business - while the company's own domain srinarayanasolarenergies.com did not load on 2026-11-21 (https, http and /about.html all failed in this pass). Ad traffic is being sent to another firm's website.

About 9 creative variants carry exactly the same offer line - 'Subsidy Upto 78,000/-(T&C Apply)' - with different headlines ('No More Electricity Bills Tension', 'Cut Off On Your Electricity Bill', 'Power Up Your Home', 'Invest For Better Future'...). That is nine ads testing nothing: the same promise, the same creative shape, the same destination.

The copy is set in bold Unicode pseudo-letters (the mathematical alphanumeric block, so 'Introducing' renders as pseudo-bold glyphs). Screen readers and some Android default fonts read those characters letter by letter or show boxes, and the body is one unbroken bold block with no line breaks between the offer and the address.

The single live ad runs no price for a specific size, no warranty term, no panel or inverter brand and no service guarantee - only a Rs.1,355 EMI for 'a 3KW system' and 'T&C Apply', with no T&C anywhere a buyer can read.

The contact email on the ad is a personal Gmail address (snepadilabad@gmail.com) rather than an address on the firm's own domain, which is the first thing a Rs.1 lakh+ buyer checks and the easiest thing to lose a lead over.
The ad has been running since 13 Nov 2026 with no landing page and no site of its own to send the click to, so every enquiry sits in a WhatsApp thread with no record of which ad produced it.
next_steps: Fix the website line in the ad - today
It currently sends buyers to another company's site. Either point it at your own domain, or remove the line until your domain resolves.
Get srinarayanasolarenergies.com back up, or replace it
The domain did not load, so the ad has no owned destination. A one-page site with the subsidy table, your address and an enquiry form, plus the Meta Pixel, is enough to start measuring this spend.
Turn nine identical creatives into three real tests

One price-led ('3 kW at Rs.X, EMI Rs.1,355'), one subsidy-led ('what the Rs.78,000 covers'), one proof-led (installs, warranty, service area). Same destination, so the winner can actually be identified.
Rewrite the copy in normal Telugu text
Bold Unicode pseudo-letters break screen readers and some Android fonts, and read as spam to the platforms. Plain Telugu with a headline, three bullets and one CTA will outperform it.
Move to a domain email address
info@srinarayanasolarenergies.com (once the domain is live) is worth more than any creative change on a purchase this size.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
